stem.text: Vanadium reacts with dilute sulfuric acid to form $\text{V}_2(\text{SO}_4)_3$ and hydrogen gas.
What happens to vanadium atoms in this reaction?

A.text: They lose three electrons and are oxidised.

B.text: They lose three electrons and are reduced.

C.text: They lose two electrons and are oxidised.

D.text: They lose two electrons and are reduced.
